'''2005 Michigan Mini-Open''' was a Star Wars CCG constructed tournament in Michigan (12 March 2005). It is known from the decklists below, recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms. A player posting as Sithborg organized it at The Bernhard Center in Kalamazoo, where a convention was being held, aiming for a Players Committee premium package; the entry fee was $10, plus the convention's fee.<ref name="pcf-4439-60324">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60324#60324 Michigan mini-open?], Sithborg, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (20 January 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050226015411/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60324%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> It started at 1 pm on Saturday 12 March 2005, when the convention fee was $10,<ref name="pcf-4439-60557">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60557#60557 Michigan mini-open?], Sithborg, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (23 January 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050226015411/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60324%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> and was planned as six games.<ref name="pcf-4439-60684">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60684#60684 Michigan mini-open?], Sithborg, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (24 January 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050226015411/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60324%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> [[Spencer Ball]] said his Guelph Crew from Ontario would attend.<ref name="pcf-4439-62063">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=62063#62063 Michigan mini-open?], Spencer Ball, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (9 February 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050226015411/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60324%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Michigan
* '''Dates:''' 12 March 2005
* '''Venue:''' The Bernhard Center, 1903 W Michigan Ave., Kalamazoo, Michigan<ref name="pcf-4439-62020">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=62020#62020 Michigan mini-open?], Sithborg, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (8 February 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050226015411/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60324%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
